title: Sugreeva kills Virupaksha
introduction: Having destroyed some monkeys in the battle-field, Ravana tries to approach Rama to continue his fight. Meanwhile, Sugreeva along with some monkeys attack some chiefs of demons and destroy them. Then, Virupaksha a demon comes and attacks Sugreeva. Sugreeva brings down a violent slap on the temple-bone of Virupaksha and kills him.
closing: इत्यार्षे स्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे षण्णवतितमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 96th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तथा तैः कृत्तगात्रैस्तु दशग्रीवेण मार्गणैः |
बभूव वसुधा तत्र प्रकीर्णा हरिभिर्वृता
verses.iast:
tathā taiḥ kṛttagātraistu daśagrIveṇa mārgaṇaiḥ |
babhUva vasudhā tatra prakIrṇā haribhirvṛtā
verses.translation: The battle-field there, on its part, was strewn on that occasion with those monkeys whose bodies had thus been torn asunder by Ravana with his arrows.

verses.devanagari:
रावणस्याप्रसह्यन् तन् शरसम्पातमेकतः |
न शेकुः सहितुन् दीप्तं पतङ्गा इव पावकम्
verses.iast:
rāvaṇasyāprasahyan tan śarasampātamekataḥ |
na śekuḥ sahitun dIptaṃ patañgā iva pāvakam
verses.translation: Those monkeys could not bear that irresistible descent of arrows loosed by Ravana, any more than moths would bear a blazing fire.

verses.devanagari:
तेअर्दिता निशितैर्बाणैः क्रोशन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः |
पावकार्चिःसमाविष्टा दह्यमाना यथा गजाः
verses.iast:
tearditā niśitairbāṇaiḥ krośanto vipradudruvuḥ |
pāvakārciḥsamāviṣṭā dahyamānā yathā gajāḥ
verses.translation: Those monkeys tormented by sharp arrows, fled away roaring, as elephants run away, when enveloped in flames of fire and getting scorched by them.

glosses.meaning: when enveloped in flames of fire

verses.devanagari:
प्लवङ्गानामनीकानि महाभ्राणीव मारुतः |
स ययौ समरे तस्मिन्विधमन्रावणः शरैः
verses.iast:
plavañgānāmanIkāni mahābhrāṇIva mārutaḥ |
sa yayau samare tasminvidhamanrāvaṇaḥ śaraiḥ
verses.translation: Ravana was marching forward swiftly in that battle-field, blowing away the army of monkeys, like the wind blows away large clouds.

verses.devanagari:
कदनन् तरसा कृत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो वनौकसाम् |
आससाद ततो युद्धे राघवन् त्वरितस्तदा
verses.iast:
kadanan tarasā kṛtvā rākṣasendro vanaukasām |
āsasāda tato yuddhe rāghavan tvaritastadā
verses.translation: Having brought about with his might the destruction of those monkeys in battle, Ravana quickly approached Rama on the battle-field.

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवस्तान्कपीन्दृष्ट्वा भग्नान्विद्रवतो रणे |
गुल्मे सुषेणं निक्षिप्य चक्रे युद्धे द्रुतं मनः
verses.iast:
sugrIvastānkapIndṛṣṭvā bhagnānvidravato raṇe |
gulme suṣeṇaṃ nikṣipya cakre yuddhe drutaṃ manaḥ
verses.translation: Seeing those monkeys running away in defeat in that battle, Sugreeva kept Sushena in charge of his army and quickly threw his mind into the fight.

glosses.meaning: as a guard for his soldiers

verses.devanagari:
आत्मनः सदृशन् वीरं स तं निक्षिप्य वानरम् |
सुग्रीवोअभिमुखः शत्रुं प्रतस्थे पादपायुधः
verses.iast:
ātmanaḥ sadṛśan vIraṃ sa taṃ nikṣipya vānaram |
sugrIvoabhimukhaḥ śatruṃ pratasthe pādapāyudhaḥ
verses.translation: Keeping that Sushena who was equal to himself, his substitute, that Sugreeva, armed with the tree as a weapon, marched forward towards the enemy.

glosses.meaning: armed witht he tree as a weapon

verses.devanagari:
पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतश्चास्य सर्वे यूथाधिपाः स्वयम् |
अनुजह्रुर्महाशैलान्विविधांश्च महाद्रुमान्
verses.iast:
pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhataścāsya sarve yUthādhipāḥ svayam |
anujahrurmahāśailānvividhāṃśca mahādrumān
verses.translation: Taking huge rocks and various kinds of trees, all the monkey-warriors followed Sugreeva at his side and behind.

verses.devanagari:
स नदन्युधि सुग्रीवः स्वरेण महता महान् |
पातयन्विविधांश्चान्याञ्जघानोत्तमराक्षसान्
verses.iast:
sa nadanyudhi sugrIvaḥ svareṇa mahatā mahān |
pātayanvividhāṃścānyāñjaghānottamarākṣasān
verses.translation: The gigantic Sugreeva roared at a high pitch in the battle-field. Striking with his blows, he crushed various other chiefs of demons.

verses.devanagari:
ममर्द च महाकायो राक्षसान्वानरेश्वरः |
युगान्तसमये वायुः प्रवृद्धानगमानिव
verses.iast:
mamarda ca mahākāyo rākṣasānvānareśvaraḥ |
yugāntasamaye vāyuḥ pravṛddhānagamāniva
verses.translation: The colossal bodied Sugreeva smashed the demons, as the grown-up trees are smashed by the wind at the time of dissolution of the world.

glosses.meaning: at the time of dissolution of the world.

verses.devanagari:
राक्षसानामनीकेषु शैलवर्षन् ववर्ष ह |
अश्ववर्षन् यथा मेघः पक्षिसङ्घेषु कानने
verses.iast:
rākṣasānāmanIkeṣu śailavarṣan vavarṣa ha |
aśvavarṣan yathā meghaḥ pakṣisañgheṣu kānane
verses.translation: Sugreeva rained a hail of rocks on the army of demons, as a cloud rains a shower of hail-stones on a host of birds in a forest.

verses.devanagari:
कपिराजविमुक्तैस्तैः शैलवर्षैस्तु राक्षसाः |
विकीर्णशिरसः पेतुर्निकृत्ता इव पर्वताः
अथ सङ्क्षीयमाणेषु राक्षसेषु समन्ततः |
सुग्रीवेण प्रभग्नेषु पतत्सु विनदत्सु च
विरूपाक्षः स्वकं नाम धन्वी विश्राव्य राक्षसः |
रथादाप्लुत्य दुर्धर्षो गजस्कन्धमुपारुहत्
verses.iast:
kapirājavimuktaistaiḥ śailavarṣaistu rākṣasāḥ |
vikIrṇaśirasaḥ peturnikṛttā iva parvatāḥ
atha sañkṣIyamāṇeṣu rākṣaseṣu samantataḥ |
sugrIveṇa prabhagneṣu patatsu vinadatsu ca
virUpākṣaḥ svakaṃ nāma dhanvI viśrāvya rākṣasaḥ |
rathādāplutya durdharṣo gajaskandhamupāruhat
verses.translation: While those demons, thus defeated by Sugreeva, falling on the floor and then roaring, get diminished in number from all sides, the indomitable Virupaksha the demon, holding a bow, pronouncing his name by himself, descended from his chariot and mounted the back of an elephant.

verses.devanagari:
स तन् द्विरदमारुह्य विरूपाक्षो महारथः |
विनदन्भीमनिर्ह्रालन् वानरानभ्यधावत
verses.iast:
sa tan dviradamāruhya virUpākṣo mahārathaḥ |
vinadanbhImanirhrālan vānarānabhyadhāvata
verses.translation: That mighty Virupaksha, mounting that elephant, then roared a terrific noise and rushed towards the monkeys.

verses.devanagari:
सुग्रीवे स शरान्घोरान्विससर्ज चमूमुखे |
स्थापयामासा चोद्विग्नान्राक्षसान्सम्प्रहर्षयन्
verses.iast:
sugrIve sa śarānghorānvisasarja camUmukhe |
sthāpayāmāsā codvignānrākṣasānsampraharṣayan
verses.translation: Virupaksha released dreadful arrows on Sugreeva who was at the front-rank of the army. He strengthened his support to the worried demons, by cheering them up.

glosses.meaning: who was as the front-rank of the army

verses.devanagari:
सोअतिविद्धः शितैर्बाणैः कपीन्द्रस्तेन रक्षसा |
चुक्रोध च महाक्रोधो वधे चास्य मनो दधे
verses.iast:
soatividdhaḥ śitairbāṇaiḥ kapIndrastena rakṣasā |
cukrodha ca mahākrodho vadhe cāsya mano dadhe
verses.translation: Sugreeva, the king of monkeys, when he was struck severely with sharp arrows by that demon, shouted loudly. With profuse anger, he set his mind on killing him.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पादपमुद्धृत्य शूरः सम्प्रधने हरिः |
अभिपत्य जघानास्य प्रमुखे तं महागजम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ pādapamuddhṛtya śUraḥ sampradhane hariḥ |
abhipatya jaghānāsya pramukhe taṃ mahāgajam
verses.translation: Uplifting a tree and coming near that huge elephant, the valiant Sugreeva, a thorough fighter, struck it on its face.

verses.devanagari:
स तु प्रहाराभिहतः सुग्रीवेण महागजः |
अपासर्पद्धनुर्मात्रं निषसाद ननाद च
verses.iast:
sa tu prahārābhihataḥ sugrIveṇa mahāgajaḥ |
apāsarpaddhanurmātraṃ niṣasāda nanāda ca
verses.translation: That huge elephant, struck with the blow of Sugreeva, receded to a distance of four yards, sank down and roared too.

glosses.meaning: to a distance of four yards

verses.devanagari:
गजात्तु मथितात्तूर्णमपक्रम्य स वीर्यवान् |
राक्षसोअभिमुखः शत्रुं प्रत्युद्गम्य ततः कपिम्
आर्षभन् चर्मखड्गं च प्रगृह्य लघुविक्रमः |
भर्त्सयन्निव सुग्रीवमाससाद व्यवस्थितम्
verses.iast:
gajāttu mathitāttUrṇamapakramya sa vIryavān |
rākṣasoabhimukhaḥ śatruṃ pratyudgamya tataḥ kapim
ārṣabhan carmakhaḍgaṃ ca pragṛhya laghuvikramaḥ |
bhartsayanniva sugrIvamāsasāda vyavasthitam
verses.translation: Descending quickly from his wounded elephant, that valiant demon then seizing hold of his sword from a shield made of a bull's hide and advancing in rapid paces, facing towards Sugreeva his enemy, approached him, who stood firm, threatening him as it were.

glosses.meaning: from a shield made of a bull's hide

verses.devanagari:
स हि तस्याभिसङ्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य महतीन् शिलाम् |
विरूपाक्षाय चिक्षेप सुग्रीवो जलदोपमाम्
verses.iast:
sa hi tasyābhisañkruddhaḥ pragṛhya mahatIn śilām |
virUpākṣāya cikṣepa sugrIvo jaladopamām
verses.translation: Taking a huge rock, which looked like a cloud, that Sugreeva, who felt enraged, threw it on Virupaksha.

verses.devanagari:
स तान् शिलामापतन्तीन् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवः |
अपक्रम्य सुविक्रान्तः खड्गेन प्राहरत्तदा
verses.iast:
sa tān śilāmāpatantIn dṛṣṭvā rākṣasapuñgavaḥ |
apakramya suvikrāntaḥ khaḍgena prāharattadā
verses.translation: Seeing that rock falling, that highly valiant and excellent of demons then receding away, struck him with a sword.

verses.devanagari:
तेन खड्गेन सङ्क्रुद्धः सुग्रीवस्य चमूमुखे |
कवचं पातयामास स खड्गाभिहतोअपतत्
verses.iast:
tena khaḍgena sañkruddhaḥ sugrIvasya camUmukhe |
kavacaṃ pātayāmāsa sa khaḍgābhihatoapatat
verses.translation: Wounded by the blow of the sword of that strong demon, Sugreeva became as though unconscious on the ground, for a moment.

glosses.meaning: by the blow of the sword

verses.devanagari:
सहसा स तदोत्पत्य राक्षसस्य महाहवे |
मुष्टिं संवर्त्य वेगेन पातयामास वक्षसि
verses.iast:
sahasā sa tadotpatya rākṣasasya mahāhave |
muṣṭiṃ saṃvartya vegena pātayāmāsa vakṣasi
verses.translation: Then, bouncing up suddenly in that great battle, Sugreeva, tightening his fist, brought it down on the demon's chest violently.

verses.devanagari:
मुष्टिप्रहाराभिहतो विरूपाक्षो निशाचरः |
तेन खड्गेन संक्रुद्धः सुग्रीवस्य चमूमुखे
कवचम् पातयामास पद्भ्यामभिहतोऽपतत् |
verses.iast:
muṣṭiprahārābhihato virūpākṣo niśācaraḥ |
tena khaḍgena saṅkruddhaḥ sugrīvasya camūmukhe
kavacam pātayāmāsa padbhyāmabhihato'patat |
verses.translation: Feeling enraged, when struck by the blow of that fist, Virupaksha the demon brought down the armour of Sugreeva by his sword at the battle-front. Thus struck by him, Sugreeva fell down from his feet.

glosses.meaning: when struck by the blow of the fist

verses.devanagari:
स समुत्थाय पतितः कपिस्तस्य व्यसर्जयत्
तलप्रहारमशनेः समानं भीमनिस्वनम् |
verses.iast:
sa samutthāya patitaḥ kapistasya vyasarjayat
talaprahāramaśaneḥ samānaṃ bhImanisvanam |
verses.translation: Getting up when fallen, Sugreeva gave him a slap, which produced a terrific sound similar to a thunder.

verses.devanagari:
तलप्रहारन् तद्रक्षः सुग्रीवेण समुद्यतम्
नैपुण्यान्मोचयित्वैनं मुष्टिनोरस्यताडयत् |
verses.iast:
talaprahāran tadrakṣaḥ sugrIveṇa samudyatam
naipuṇyānmocayitvainaṃ muṣṭinorasyatāḍayat |
verses.translation: Setting himself free from that slap, which was about to be raised by Sugreeva skillfully, Virupaksha the demon struck Sugreeva on the chest with his fist.

glosses.meaning: which was about to be raised

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु सङ्क्रुद्धतरः सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः
मोक्षितन् चात्मनो दृष्ट्वा प्रहारं तेन रक्षसा |
verses.iast:
tatastu sañkruddhataraḥ sugrIvo vānareśvaraḥ
mokṣitan cātmano dṛṣṭvā prahāraṃ tena rakṣasā |
verses.translation: Then, seeing that demon escaping his blow, Sugreeva the monkey-king for his part, very much enraged.

glosses.meaning: the king of monkeys for his part

verses.devanagari:
स ददर्शान्तरन् तस्य विरूपाक्षस्य वानरः
ततो न्यपातयत्क्रोधाच्छङ्खदेशे महातलम् |
verses.iast:
sa dadarśāntaran tasya virUpākṣasya vānaraḥ
tato nyapātayatkrodhācchañkhadeśe mahātalam |
verses.translation: That monkey saw an opportunity to strike that Virupaksha. Then, with anger, Sugreeva brought down another violent slap on his temple-bone.

verses.devanagari:
महेन्द्राशनिकल्पेन तलेनाभिहतः क्षितौ
पपात रुधिरक्लिन्नः शोणितन् स समुद्वमन् |
स्रोतोभ्यस्तु विरूपाक्षो जलं रस्रवणादिव
verses.iast:
mahendrāśanikalpena talenābhihataḥ kṣitau
papāta rudhiraklinnaḥ śoṇitan sa samudvaman |
srotobhyastu virūpākṣo jalaṃ rasravaṇādiva
verses.translation: Virupaksha, struck by the blow of that palm, which was like the thunderbolt to the ground, oozing blood profusely from the (nine) apertures* of his body, as water flows from the spring.
notes: * Nine apertures of body are two eyes, two nostrils, two ears, mouth, penis and anus.

glosses.meaning: like the thunderbolt of Indra the lord of celestials
from that apertures of his body

verses.devanagari:
विवृत्तनयनन् क्रोधात्सफेन रुधिराप्लुतम् |
ददृशुस्ते विरूपाक्षन् विरूपाक्षतरन् कृतम्
verses.iast:
vivṛttanayanan krodhātsaphena rudhirāplutam |
dadṛśuste virUpākṣan virUpākṣataran kṛtam
verses.translation: The monkeys saw Virupaksha, bathed in foaming blood, with his eyes rolling through anger and as such rendered all the more deformed.*
notes: * There is a pun here on the word 'Virupaksha' which means one with deformed eyes.

glosses.meaning: and as such rendered all the more deformed.*

verses.devanagari:
स्फुरन्तं परिवर्जन्तं पार्श्वेन रुधिरोक्षितम् |
करुणन् च विनर्दान्तं ददृशुः कपयो रिपुम्
verses.iast:
sphurantaṃ parivarjantaṃ pārśvena rudhirokṣitam |
karuṇan ca vinardāntaṃ dadṛśuḥ kapayo ripum
verses.translation: The monkeys saw their enemy, bathed in blood, turning to and from as also throbbing on his sides and roaring piteously.

verses.devanagari:
तथा तु तौ सन्यति सम्प्रयुक्तौ |
तरस्विनौ वानरराक्षसानाम् |
बलार्णवौ सस्वनतुः सभीमं |
महार्णवौ द्वाविव भिन्नवेलौ
verses.iast:
tathā tu tau sanyati samprayuktau |
tarasvinau vānararākṣasānām |
balārṇavau sasvanatuḥ sabhImaṃ |
mahārṇavau dvāviva bhinnavelau
verses.translation: Confronting together in the battle-field in that way, those two violent and terrific armies which were extensive as oceans, of monkeys and demons, roared like two large oceans which had burst their bounds.

glosses.meaning: armies which were extensive as seas

verses.devanagari:
विनाशितं प्रेक्ष्य विरूपनेत्रं |
महाबलन् तन् हरिपार्थिवेन |
बलन् समस्तन् कपिराक्षसानाम् |
उन्मत्तगङ्गाप्रतिमं बभूव
verses.iast:
vināśitaṃ prekṣya virUpanetraṃ |
mahābalan tan haripārthivena |
balan samastan kapirākṣasānām |
unmattagañgāpratimaṃ babhUva
verses.translation: Beholding that mighty Virupaksha killed by Sugreeva, the army of monkeys and demons together looked like the agitated river of Ganga.

glosses.meaning: like the agitatd river of Ganga.
